  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Information Technology: Development of artificial intelligence that learns from humans, sophisticated virtual reality systems, and new methods of quantum computing that are faster and more reliable.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Biotechnology: Development of gene editing techniques to cure genetic diseases and enhance human performance, along with new drugs and therapies for a wider range of diseases.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Space Exploration: Establishment of permanent settlements on the moon, beginning terraforming Mars, and development of new propulsion technologies that can travel faster than the speed of light, such as warp drives or wormholes.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Environmental Science: Development of strategies for capturing and storing carbon dioxide to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and experimentation with geoengineering techniques to cool the planet.
